name: filedeck
description: Web file manager: per-node agents plus a hub SPA

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev:agent: FILEDECK_MODE=agent FILEDECK_ROOT=${FILEDECK_ROOT:-$HOME} npm run dev -w server
scripts.check:neutral: ! grep -rIil -e Filedeck server/src server/test web/src web/index.html web/public Dockerfile tsconfig.base.json README.md
